comment: Packets whose encoding differs from the BDS-derived schemas and which are reviewed and accepted. Anything NOT listed here fails the check. Every entry must say why the difference is acceptable and what would settle it; 'not investigated' is not a reason to add one.

packets.name: HurtArmour
packets.reason: Being fixed. ArmourSlots is written with Varint64 (zigzag) but is a bitset, so zigzagging shifts every bit. CloudburstMC writes it unsigned, the BDS dump types it uvarint64, and Mojang's docs mark it unsigned. Remove this entry once the fix lands.

packets.name: SubChunk
packets.reason: Not a wire difference - the comparison is too coarse. The heightmap is a 2D 16x16 array of int8 and gophertunnel stores the same 256 bytes flat. Remove once the comparator flattens nested fixed arrays.

packets.name: EditorNetwork
packets.reason: gophertunnel is very likely correct. It writes a bool then one NetworkLittleEndian NBT payload, and CloudburstMC does the same; the BDS dump appears to describe the payload's interior (a variant name and data) rather than its framing.

packets.name: ServerBoundDiagnostics
packets.reason: gophertunnel is very likely correct. It writes SystemCategories and WhiskerScopes as plain slices and CloudburstMC also writes them unconditionally; the BDS dump marks System Categories optional.

packets.name: UpdateAbilities
packets.reason: Unsettled, one source each way. gophertunnel writes Layers with SliceUint8Length (U8 count); the BDS dump says a uvarint32 prefix. Mojang's schema states no prefix override, which merely implies the varint default rather than positively confirming it. Needs a packet capture.

packets.name: StructureBlockUpdate
packets.reason: Unsettled optionality. gophertunnel writes both structure names unconditionally; the BDS dump marks the redacted name optional. Needs a packet capture.

packets.name: EducationSettings
packets.reason: Both sources agree the packet has optionals - gophertunnel uses OptionalFunc for CanModifyBlocks and OverrideURI and OptionalMarshaler for ExternalLinkSettings - but the presence boundaries land at different positions. Needs per-field adjudication.

packets.name: CameraPresets
packets.reason: Deeply nested preset payload; the difference is in optional presence inside nested definitions. Needs per-field adjudication.
